evals.name: Scope coverage remains explicit
evals.prompt: Prepare workshop topics from the supplied process scope and simplification impacts.
evals.expected_output: FI and SD workshop topics with their impact IDs, plus a review-required row for the process with no module.

assertions.name: all_processes_reported
assertions.description: Every supplied process appears once in coverage.

assertions.name: missing_module_visible
assertions.description: The missing module is Review required, not silently grouped.

assertions.name: no_workshop_decision
assertions.description: Output only prepares decisions; it does not claim Standard or Delta.
